plugins.name: zcode-pet
plugins.description: ZCode desktop pet: floating pet + menu bar show the running task count; task completion/failure is surfaced on the pet itself (celebration animation + unread badge), no system notifications

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 桌面宠物：悬浮宠物+菜单栏实时显示执行中任务数；任务完成/出错由宠物本体直接提示（庆祝动画+未读角标），不发系统通知
